name: o-json: select two fields in SPLIT

setup.note: Start o-json with no file. Press e to choose the tutorial document.
M opens SPLIT on the edited copy, with reshaped data in the preview. :restructure clear empties the new structure; ctrl+w h returns to the original before we copy source fields.

actions.label: Mark the selected fields
actions.caption: space marks both selected fields so you can flatten or keep them later, even after leaving VISUAL. Watch the marked count.

actions.label: Leave VISUAL
actions.caption: esc leaves VISUAL without changing the structure. Use it when the selection is ready and you want to move normally.

actions.label: Put a field in the right structure
actions.caption: p puts the saved city field into the right structure, replacing first and last. Use VISUAL put to swap a group of fields in one step; u can undo it.

actions.label: Copy the selected fields
actions.caption: y copies both selected fields for reuse in a structure. It leaves VISUAL and keeps the fields where they are.

actions.label: Delete the selected fields
actions.caption: d removes both selected fields in one undo step. Use it to leave out private names before sharing the restructured JSON.

actions.label: Flatten names into rows
actions.caption: F flattens the two selected fields into one row per customer. The name wrapper disappears, making first and last easy to export as columns.

actions.label: Wrap the fields in an object
actions.caption: S wraps both selected fields in one new object. Type fullName, then esc: the wrapper groups first and last under a useful name.

actions.label: Wrap the values in an array
actions.caption: [ wraps the selected values into an array. Type parts, then esc: first and last become ordered values, useful when the output needs a name-parts list.

actions.label: Move the fields out one level
actions.caption: < moves both fields out of name by one level. They become direct customer fields, saving a nested lookup in the output.

actions.label: Finish a selection at an edge
actions.caption: > nests a selection into the object above. Here there is no sibling object above these fields, so it ends VISUAL and leaves them in place.

notes.note: Reset point: first and last are selected in the right structure. Each lesson starts here again.
